title: Redstone Expansion
description: Added many practical redstone components, very suitable for players who love redstone.
body:
Added many practical redstone components, very suitable for players who love redstone. Each component can be pushed by a piston for automation.

# Introduction

## User
![User](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db6f2772c8392284d036611b24fdfc0f01bf36b4_0.webp)

It can interact with blocks or entities ahead, with the farthest interaction distance equal to the strength of the received redstone signal. For example, fertilizing, opening doors, building roads, etc.

## Excavator
![Excavator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a949b49af65f2946afcf9b570f9f9f2bb32c1193_0.webp)

It can excavate the blocks ahead, and the maximum excavation distance depends on the strength of the input redstone signal. You can place a tool in it.

## Wireless Transmitter & Wireless Receiver
![Wireless Transmitter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e0335adebdf66a931b27c8ca283b2f2e76e52bf_0.webp)
![Wireless Receiver](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f11e70aa9ace19f413d9ebe1f93e8dacd144e40_0.webp)

The Wireless Transmitter can transmit redstone signals to Wireless Receivers on the same channel. You can right-click on them or send redstone pulse signals to their left or right to change the channel.

## Relay Chest
![Relay Chest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3864e483886ef6d86c1cbf28fa431d41bd1bf88d_0.webp)

A chest used for remote transmission of items. It has two modes of input and output. The input mode chest will transfer items to the input mode chest on the same channel. The transmission speed depends on the strength of the receive redstone signal. Both modes of chests require receive of redstone signals to work.

## Inverter
![Inverter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96513f16bcd4be21977aa323e9201170a8f86a81_0.webp)

Reverse the strength of the input redstone signal. Output = 15 - Input.

## Pulser
![Pulser](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc041fe1ec8c905967974d9f969c921dd1305b0c_0.webp)

Convert continuous input signals into pulse signals. Right click to adjust pulse frequency.

## Magnet Hopper
![Magnet Hopper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/daeafb2e27568ca617dd0175747db1be94f00157_0.webp)

It can collect items with a maximum radius of 7.

## Strong Piston
![Strong Piston](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7b449fb578b7ea527f5c4926741640105165d4a_0.webp)

It can simultaneously push or pull up to 15 blocks ahead (the maximum number depends on the strength of the input redstone signal).

## Consumption Detector
![Consumption Detector](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f59c56fab2fcb611ec4ea0c8884a0a1be65f939c_0.webp)

Right click on one side of the handheld item. When you consume or use the item, it will emit a redstone pulse signal forward. You can use it to make escape or teleportation devices.

## Redstone Dial
![Redstone Dial](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5938f756ac4a58dcf5fd2f0df42ee5bbf63d583a_0.webp)

Right click to set the output redstone signal strength. Inputting redstone pulse signals to the left/right can also reduce/increase the strength of redstone signals.

## Chunk Loader
![Chunk Loader](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23832725ba74f3724ced2a52ba7c92c11ff0d385_0.webp)

Force loading of surrounding blocks. Radius = Strength of redstone signal / 4. Right click to view the currently loaded block range.
